title: Density uniform on a subset
statement: Let $A$ be a nonempty subset of $\\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The density uniform on $A$ is the normalized indicator of $A$, giving a probability density on the Boolean cube.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a subset of the Boolean cube
